_comment: The pre-registration of agent_architecture.md §7's last reporting rule: budget
and hyperparameters are fixed before any test run, all method debugging happens
on train, and every arm is reported on test — never 'best of'. Committed before
the registered search and before any test rollout; its sha256 travels with every
run (harness/preregistration.py), so an edit after the fact moves the hash rather
than quietly redefining what was promised. Amendments are appended to
'amendments' with their reason, never applied by rewriting a value in place.

registered_against.note: T127, the run ledger. The last commit before any test rollout exists.

baseline: The handwritten seed candidate at the pinned candidate_prompt_versions — the
evaluation root instruction plus the six tool texts, registered once and read
twice (T125), so the reference arm and the search's seed cannot drift apart.
It enters at 0.50 abstention accuracy by choice: T107 found T17a failing 3/3
on the handwritten instruction with correct reasoning and a wrong contract
encoding, and left it for the search, because the encoding lives in the
optimizable text. A candidate repairing it is measuring what the thesis claims
to measure, and this sentence exists so that improvement cannot later be read
as a baseline that was quietly weakened.
optimized: Whatever candidate the one registered search selects. Not the best of several
searches, not the best iteration by test score, not a hand-picked candidate:
the search's own selection, on the aggregated scalar, over train alone.

measurement.pairing: the identical committed cases, in file order, for every arm and every repeat

analysis.repeat_reduction: mean over the three repeats per case, before any aggregation over cases
analysis.primary_estimand: the paired difference optimized - baseline, per metric, on test_seen
analysis.test_unseen_trajectory: per-template win/loss table; no accuracy and no interval
analysis.abstention: accuracy over the unanswerable cases and the false-abstention rate over the answerable ones, reported separately and never blended
analysis.exclusion: harness_error cases leave every aggregate and are counted per arm with their sources broken out; invalid_argument never excludes
analysis.parse_failure: reported apart from answer accuracy, so a candidate degrading the output format stays distinguishable from one degrading reasoning
analysis.residual_nondeterminism: the share of cases whose three repeats do not agree, per arm and split, reported as the noise floor every arm difference is read against
analysis.multiplicity: no correction across the four metrics. They are four declared quantities, not a family searched over for a winner; the interval and the noise floor carry the uncertainty and the suite is stated to detect large effects only

method_debugging: train only. Every defect the pilot and the packets found was found on train
or on the pilot's own cases; the two test splits have never been run.
reporting: Both arms on all three splits, whatever the numbers are. A repeated run is
reported as a repeat, and §7's own repeat condition is the only one that
licenses it: residual failure counts diverging between arms mean the arms
were not measured under the same conditions. Diverging newly-recorded cache
entry counts are reported and never repaired.
stopping: The measurement is complete when both arms have three repeats on all three
